app.disclaimer: A lookup aid, not a diagnosis. Suggestions need clinician review.
input.label: Clinical information
input.placeholder: Enter ultrasound findings, gestational age, measurements, and any assessment limitations…
phenotype.foundCount: {{count}} findings. Select a row to see details, add a note or edit.
phenotype.emptyHint: Analyze the case description to view extracted findings and suggested HPO terms.
mapping.AMBIGUOUS: Unclear which HPO term applies. Select Edit to choose one.
mapping.UNMAPPED: No matching HPO term found. Select Edit to reword the finding and search again.
results.emptyHint: Select Continue in the HPO list to explore related diseases and genes.
results.scoreHint: Ordered by how well they match the fetal findings, not by diagnostic probability. Select a disease to see the basis.
results.insufficient: Not enough evidence to suggest candidates.
chat.title: Ask a follow-up
chat.placeholder: Ask about the reviewed findings or evidence…
evidence.title: Source details
notice.noFindings: No findings identified. Add more detail or choose another example.
profile.title: User profile
history.emptyHint: Cases you create are kept here until you delete them.
help.language.vi: Switch the interface to Vietnamese. The clinical description stays unchanged.
help.language.en: Switch the interface to English. The clinical description stays unchanged.
help.newCase: Start a new case. Previously analyzed cases remain in case history.
help.history: Reopen a conversation and continue reviewing the case.
help.collapse: Collapse the side panel to make more room for your workspace.
finding.notePlaceholder: Comment on the term, information to check, or context for this analysis…
help.note: Notes are sent as context when updating results; they do not change HPO mappings or clinical assertions.
workflow.help1: Enter the clinical description, examination findings and assessment limitations. Analyze the description to identify findings for review.
workflow.help2: Check the HPO terms and source excerpts, edit or add notes if needed, then continue. To change the whole description, choose Edit description.
workflow.help3: Explore disease and gene suggestions based on the current HPO list. Check relevance and open the supporting evidence.
help.editDescription: Return to the case description to edit the input and regenerate the full HPO list.
welcome.title: Describe the case
welcome.hint: Enter the clinical information to start an analysis.
outline.title: Case progress
phenotype.usedForResults: {{count}} findings · {{used}} used to search for diseases
finding.excludeLabel: Do not use this finding to find diseases
finding.remapHint: The system looks up HPO terms again for this finding only.
match.disease_more_specific: disease records a more specific form
match.disease_more_general: disease records a more general form
results.unmentioned: Common in this disease but not mentioned
results.literatureFailed: Could not load the literature part for this disease.
results.skipped: Findings not used to find diseases ({{count}})
chat.lockedReview: Press Continue in the findings list before asking more.
evidence.gone: This passage is no longer in the library.
evidence.inactive: This passage is no longer in active use in the library.
notice.caseExpired: This case is no longer on the server (it was deleted).
notice.notAnalyzed: This message was not read as findings; the answer is just below.
notice.splitFailed: The description could not be analysed (split step failed). Try analysing again.
error.caseBusy: This case is busy with another request. Try again in a moment.
error.waitingReview: This case is waiting for your review of the findings.
error.modelUnavailable: The model is not responding. Please try again.
results.recorded: Fetal findings recorded for this disease
results.frequencyHint: "n/m patients": of m patients described in the cited paper, n had the finding. Rare diseases are often reported in only a few patients, so the numbers are small: real data, but thin evidence. Frequency is not the fetus's risk.
results.notRecorded: Not in this disease's HPO data
results.hiddenNoMatch: {{count}} diseases that share no fetal finding are not shown.
results.noLiterature: The document library has nothing on this disease yet; the basis is only the HPO data and the papers cited above.
finding.measureHint: The description gives only the number, with no conclusion. The system does not read the number; the clinician chooses the status.
finding.measureAbnormalHint: Choose the HPO concept that matches the clinician's conclusion.
finding.measureWrite: Or write the conclusion in the clinician's words
results.usedTerms: {{count}} fetal findings used to search for diseases:
skipReason.not_fetal: not a finding of the fetus
skipReason.state_not_used: this state is not used to search for diseases
skipReason.absent_checked: only used to check against the diseases
skipReason.not_in_kb: code no longer in the HPO data
skipReason.excluded_by_doctor: removed from the search by the clinician
results.conflicts: Recorded as absent in the fetus, frequent in this disease
results.conflictsHint: A feature not seen in the fetus at this exam may appear later or be hard to see on ultrasound; conflicts are for the clinician to weigh and do not change the order of suggestions.
phenotype.carryOver: Re-applied {{applied}} corrections from the previous analysis.
phenotype.carryOverPartial: Re-applied {{applied}} corrections; {{missing}} no longer match a finding of the new description.
phenotype.undecidedMeasurements: {{count}} undecided measurements will not be used to search for diseases.
results.summaryOutdated: The earlier summary was written for the previous list.
results.rewriteSummaryRequest: Rewrite the summary for the current list of suggestions.
